video_title: Jalen Brunson, Karl-Anthony Towns & Mike Brown Celebrate NBA Finals Victory, React to Superstitions

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the Knicks' historic championship run
quotes.excerpt: the opportunity presented itself, we won that as a team, we found a way to do it
quotes.quote: The opportunity presented itself, we won that as a team, we found a way to do it, fighting back all those games and it was worth it.

quotes.speaker: Mike Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Brown on identifying the Knicks' championship potential
quotes.excerpt: you see the different guys that you have that make up this team and you're like
quotes.quote: Before my interview process, you have to obviously prepare for the interview, and doing that, you see the different guys that you have that make up this team and you're like, we might have a chance at this thing. I don't need to say anything now, just let the process be what it's going to be, but knowing going into it, I really felt like we had an opportunity.

quotes.speaker: Mike Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Brown on the origin of the 'Who Let the Dogs Out' chant
quotes.excerpt: I was an assistant in San Antonio, the reporter that asked me that question, he said
quotes.quote: I was an assistant in San Antonio, the reporter that asked me that question, he said, what did you learn during your time here when you coached the seven-year-old dogs flag football team? And so I said, I learned to cheer. We used to have all the parents come into the huddle, all the kids come into the huddle before every game. We put everybody put their hands in, and then I'd go, one, two, three, I go, who let the dogs out? And then one player on our team, he tapped my back, rubbed my shoulder, he looked down at me, gave me the sorry-felt look and he said, don't worry about it, coach. It was McKale Bridges.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on the emotional significance of winning the NBA title
quotes.excerpt: when you got drafted, you want to win an NBA title, and to come back here sitting
quotes.quote: When you got drafted, you want to win an NBA title, and to come back here sitting talking to you again with the NBA title, I did what I was supposed to do.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on the diverse backgrounds of the Knicks roster
quotes.excerpt: everyone had a different background, had a different story, how they got to this seat
quotes.quote: Everyone had a different background, had a different story, how they got to this seat to be here on the Knicks up 3-1 in San Antonio, and those stories you realize it doesn't matter where you come from, what your background, the trials and tribulations you face, as long as you believe in yourself and you are willing to put the work in, anyone, kids growing up in New York, kids growing up all around the world have the chance to be a New York Knick as long as they want to do it and they got to be willing to put the work in.
